Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:

It grew into resolving every Codex review thread, a PR 83 hand-off comment, triage, requirement mapping fixes, fixing misfiled session-log records, fixing the simulated Windows test host, and merging PR 82 if it was complete. PR 82 was merged as `ace70daa963287ff43273c1d19754549a13abe2d`.

   - Latest operator decisions on the green-suite work, from AskUserQuestion:
     - "Plan first, approve later": write a decision-complete plan with a per-test diagnosis and exact fixes, then stop for approval before any code.
     - "Full suite on Windows too": keep the 16 Windows-only tests as they are and also run the full suite on PAYTON-LEGION2. Windows must show 0 failed and 0 skipped; Linux keeps reporting those 16 as skipped.
     - "Tag them Integration (Recommended)": verify that the 3 provider tests are integration tests, add `Category=Integration`, and make them pass in `MigrationIntegrationTests` on PAYTON-LEGION2.
     - "Leave merged, fix forward (Recommended)": keep PR 82 merged.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - BDPv4: requirements first, then tests and scripted mock data, then a mock gate with negative controls, then production code, then the full Nuke gate at 0 failed and 0 skipped. A baseline-equal gate is never acceptable, and must never be offered or recommended.
   - Contract-base test pattern: `WorkspacePathNormalizerContractTests` (abstract), run by `WorkspacePathNormalizerMockDataTests` against `ScriptedWorkspacePathNormalizer` (a literal table) and by `WorkspacePathNormalizerRealTests` against production. Negative controls follow "…NegativeControls_AreRejectedInsidePassingHarness" with `Assert.NotNull(Record.Exception(...))`.
   - Nuke targets:
     - `./build.ps1 Test --test-run-id <id>` writes TRX to `TestResults/<id>/unit/<project>/<project>.trx`.
     - `MigrationIntegrationTests` depends on `InstallTestDependencies`, which is Windows-only (LocalDB MSI, Windows PostgreSQL zip).
     - The Test filter is `Category!=AiReview&Category!=Integration`.
   - MCP plugin 1.120.0 at `~/.claude/plugins/cache/mcpserver-local/mcpserver/1.120.0`. Calls go through `lib/repl-invoke.ps1`, with the generic `client.*` passthrough binding by parameter name.
   - The hook cache `.mcpServer/claude` is shared across concurrent Claude sessions. That violates FR-MCP-REPL-008 and misfiles prompts into other sessions. Workaround: open my own turns by explicit requestId with `client.SessionLog.BeginTurnAsync`, in session `ClaudeCode-20261019T134748Z-plugin-session`.
   - The failsafe queue is split: hooks write `.mcpServer/failsafe/ClaudeCode/...`; the wrapper with `PLUGIN_AGENT_NAME=Claude` reads `.mcpServer/failsafe/Claude/...`. My `CcPlugin.ps1` now accepts `-AgentName`.
   - The forward-slash workspace-key change (P1.4, TR-MCP-PATHNORM-001) left stale backslash test expectations. `ExpectedWorkspaceKey.Of` is the test-side oracle (`docs/plans/2026-10-07-federation-fixes.md:159`).

questions.question: How should git ignore line endings across the lab from now on? Both machines already set core.autocrlf=false, core.whitespace=cr-at-eol and merge.renormalize=true. But renormalize does nothing without a text attribute, so CRLF/LF flips still conflict (reproduced in a throwaway repo).

options.label: Global text=auto (Recommended)
options.description: Add '* text=auto' to the global git attributes file on LAB-OMARCHY (~/.config/git/attributes) and PAYTON-LEGION2 (C:\Users\kingd\.config\git\attributes); no other setting changes. Experiment result: the merge is clean, both edits kept. Effects in every repo: a file changed on both sides of a merge is committed with LF; files already committed with CRLF are otherwise left alone.

options.label: Per-merge -Xignore-cr-at-eol
options.description: No config change. Every merge I run uses -Xignore-cr-at-eol, recorded as a memory rule. Experiment result: clean, both edits kept, but a merged file can mix CRLF and LF lines. Only covers merges run with that option, not other tools or agents.

options.label: Strengthen ACs, fix both (Recommended)
options.description: Requirements first through the plugin: TR-MCP-NUKE-019 AC-6 gains owned-instance configuration containment (the temporary instance's database, workspace and marker stay inside its owned root; canonical and legacy inputs cannot override them; a conflicting destination is refused before start). TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006 and TR-MCP-USECASE-019 AC-008 gain explicit-baseline environment deltas (equal values omitted, changed values kept, independent of the ambient environment). This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - **The effort:** finish PR 87, sharpninja/McpServer#87.
     - TODO: IMPL-UNITGREEN-001. Branch: fix/unit-suite-green-20261019.
     - Worktree: /home/sharpninja/github/McpServer/.worktrees/unit-suite-green-20261019.
     - Process: BDPv4, then hostile validation (HV) round 9 by Codex gpt-6-astra max.
     - HV is unbounded in time and size; kill a run only after more than 30 minutes with no stream update. Policy 7.9 applies: the request supplies the TRX, and the reviewer builds and runs nothing.
   - **Round 8b remedy (operator decisions 08:45:44):**
     - "Strengthen ACs, fix both (Recommended)".
     - "Run the 2 classes, AC first (Recommended)".
     - "Port ac-5/ac-6 into PR 87" (about 10:53).
   - **Operator messages this segment:**
     - "/add-profile and ensure you read MEMORY-PROCESS-010 before continuing". Done.
     - "also read the other global memories and workspace memories, except global memory 007". Done: Global INFRA-001, PROCEDURE-001, PROCESS-009 and PROCESS-010; Workspace DEVPROCESS-001 and PROCESS-001.
     - "Then tell me how the memories and profile reload shape your next steps". Answered.
     - "add high todo: Create a BDPv4 Best Practices Document". Done as PLAN-BDPV4BESTPRACTICES-001.
     - "then resume work". Done.
     - "perform a holistic review of all changes in the branch before next HV". Done: findings file plus decisions.
     - "AC should primarily exist on FR." Followed by "Move criteria that are misplaced.  Unit tests are for FR, Integration tests are for TR."
   - **Holistic review decisions (about 12:08):**
     - AC changes: "Lane ACs (Recommended), Environment ACs (Recommended), QuadBrain ACs (Recommended), gh foreign-workspace AC (Recommended)".
     - Lab names: "Scrub everything in PR 87".
     - Lane flake: "Diagnose and fix in PR 87 (Recommended)".
     - Rulings: "Isolate the REPL trust cache" and "Tag checkout-reading Build.Tests".
     - The unselected rulings go to a NEW TODO: RINT-8 (restore the physical marker walk case) and MCPT-10 (a fixture for the sibling-checkout test).
   - **Security and standing constraints (verbatim, preserved):**
     - "never read, print or copy /etc/samba/cred-legion2 or any password. Treat the other machine's tree as read-only unless I say otherwise, and never commit, push or run builds in it from here. Its McpServer is a separate store."
     - ~/.creds: "Read and use, never print".
     - MEMORY-INFRA-001: "Never put passwords or private key contents in commands, logs, chat, memory or commits."
     - "NEVER Move a file. Always copy, verify and RETAIN original until I tell you it's clear to delete it."
     - Never force-push.
     - No Python, no Node.
     - Bash only runs `pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File <script.ps1>` with literal arguments: no -Command, no $ or backticks, no pipes, no &&. Quote any argument that holds ; or *.
     - Every script is analyzed with Invoke-Analyzer.ps1 before it runs.
     - State-changing scripts get a -WhatIf dry run first.
     - Plugin routes only for the session log, TODOs, requirements and triage.
     - No tables, no en or em dashes. A measured local timestamp opens every text block.
     - Commits are signed "Signed: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh@ClaudeCode | Confidence: correctness N%, accuracy N%, completeness N%" plus "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>".
     - add-profile is the first action after every compaction. The skill now also requires live MCP memory reads (Global then Workspace, sorted, excluding MEMORY-PROCESS-007) after verifying plugin identity and trust; use Invoke-MemoryLoad.ps1.
     - ACs define tests, never environment setup; no lab names in tests or ACs.
     - Present projected problems to the operator before HV.
     - Never move files; never permanently delete.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **BDPv4 order:** requirements, then contract tests with scripted reference and negative controls, then a green mock gate, then production, then binding, then the full gates.
   - **Nuke Test:** full unit run via Start-NukeRun.ps1 with a --test-run-id.
   - **Build.Tests:** infrastructure; run raw `dotnet test` via Invoke-BuildTestsRun.ps1 -Filter.
   - **Lane MigrationIntegrationTests (seven projects):**
     - Per-project filter: `<host filter>&(FullyQualifiedName~.Class.|...)`.
     - Support.Mcp.IntegrationTests runs only RequirementScopeLayerReplIntegrationTests and QuadBrainOllamaEndpointIntegrationTests.
   - **Temporary-instance containment (TR-MCP-NUKE-019 AC-6):**
     - BuildOwnedInstanceEnvironment strips product namespaces (Mcp__, QBrainAi__, MCP_, QBRAINAI_, MCPSERVER_, ConnectionStrings__) and the fallbacks DATABASE_URL and POSTGRES_CONNECTION_STRING.
     - CheckOwnedInstanceEnvironment and CheckDatabaseSelection: the last Data Source wins; containment by path segments.
   - **QuadBrainOpenAiChatService (FR-MCP-QBOPENAI-001 ac-5 and ac-6):**
     - noToolsOffered: a non-envelope reply is final after one round.
     - A spent 8-round budget returns lastArbiterOutput formatted for display.
   - **AC placement rule (new):** unit-proved criteria on the FR, integration-proved on the TR; split mixed ones. Build.Tests are infrastructure, so Nuke criteria stay on TR-MCP-NUKE-*.
   - **Session log:**
     - Session ClaudeCode-20261019T134748Z-plugin-session; the hook's turns go to failsafe.
     - I open turns with Begin-Turn.ps1, patch with Update-Turn.ps1 (.psd1 data) and close with Complete-Turn.ps1.

OperatorAndDecisionEvents.Text:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - **Current effort:** get PR 87 merged (https://github.com/sharpninja/McpServer/pull/87).
     - TODO: IMPL-UNITGREEN-001. Branch: `fix/unit-suite-green-20261019`. Worktree: `/home/sharpninja/github/McpServer/.worktrees/unit-suite-green-20261019`.
     - Process: BDPv4. HV round 9 before merge; merge needs the operator's go.
   - **Latest substantive request:** "Use the new handoff to create a detailed and actionable plan to get PR87 merged." The plan is approved and in execution. Plan file: `/home/sharpninja/.claude/plans/crispy-knitting-seal.md`; tracked copy is plan section 27.19.
   - **Operator rulings, 2026-11-02 (verbatim where quoted):**
     - HV reviewer: Codex CLI, gpt-6-astra, max effort. "HV must only be run on merged OMARCHY worktree, not on Windows."
     - "Please do Windows-only work on a child branch of the worktree and do not block work on Omarchy because failures on Windows unless they block a merge point."
     - "Do not stop on triage failures. Ensure the failsafe was written, then move on."
     - "Use dedicated targets or an integration target that accepts an array of tests groups to run." This became TR-MCP-NUKE-020 and the Nuke target TestGroups.
     - "Please write a global memory sharing this for all agents on both lab machines." Done: MEMORY-PROCESS-012 v2, on both machines.
     - "This HAS to be fixed." (createdAt-on-read). Fixed inside PR 87 as slice P under FR-MCP-040 ac-1.
     - "The MCP Server write read-only exports for requirements." The main checkout's modified FR doc is expected; don't touch it.
     - "Audit the mappings to determine what their actual state should be." Done.
     - "There is a separate worktree with federation updates. Drop a not in it explaining the removal so it can recreate them." The chosen location was the LEGION2 federation-fixes folder. Done.
     - "It would be great if you and claude could agree on a PS helper format and be able to reuse each other's work." Answer: "Lab repo. Communicate with a folder in that repo."
     - Answers to my questions:
       - Delete FR-MCP-USECASE-016/017 again with receipts.
       - "Retire placeholders, map TIMER".
       - Keep the 4 identifier-scrub assertions as flagged exceptions.
       - FR-MCP-074: "Restore edge, retire later".
       - TestGroups: "Add both ACs" (AC-4, AC-5).
       - MEMORY-FACT-008: "Retrofit at next checkpoint (Recommended)".
       - "Yes, start it now" (Windows lane).
       - LEGION2 MEMORY-PROCESS-011: "Keep it; use it in the HV brief (Recommended)". My first framing of that question was wrong.
   - **Security constraints (verbatim, still in force):**
     - "never read, print or copy /etc/samba/cred-legion2 or any password. Treat the other machine's tree as read-only unless I say otherwise, and never commit, push or run builds in it from here. Its McpServer is a separate store."
     - ~/.creds: "Read and use, never print".
     - MEMORY-INFRA-001: "Never put passwords or private key contents in commands, logs, chat, memory or commits." Also: "Do not reuse the retired id_ed25519_legion2, id_ed25519_lab_omarchy, or pi3-bridge-ed25519 identities for new connections."
     - "NEVER Move a file. Always copy, verify and RETAIN original until I tell you it's clear to delete it."
     - Never force-push. Never reset, clean or stash.
     - No Python, no Node.
     - Bash only runs `pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File <script.ps1>` with literal args (no -Command, $, backticks, pipes, &&). Quote args holding ; or *. Use the `"-ExtraArgs:--..."` colon form for values starting with `--`.
     - Analyze every script (Invoke-Analyzer.ps1) before running it. Run -WhatIf first for state changes.
     - Plugin routes only for the session log, TODO, requirements, triage and memory. Never print the marker API key.
     - No tables, no em/en dashes, and a measured local timestamp opens each text block.
     - Commit signing: "Signed: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh@ClaudeCode | Confidence: correctness N%, accuracy N%, completeness N%" plus "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>".
     - add-profile is the first action after every compaction (read PROFILE-MERGED.md in full, then Invoke-MemoryLoad.ps1).
     - Never process MEMORY-PROCESS-007 (the hook may inject it; ignore it).
     - Present every projected problem and get confirmation before HV.
     - MEMORY-FACT-008 (new Global): "From now on, every code change must have proper XML documentation that describes the affected code and includes a dated change log listing the associated canonical requirements and descriptive acceptance-criterion IDs, plus what changed and why..." Format: `<remarks><list type="table"><listheader><term>Date</term><description>Requirements; AC; change and reason</description></listheader><item><term>YYYY-MM-DD</term><description>FR-ID; AC-ID: change and reason.</description></item></list></remarks>`. Use colons instead of the template's em dash.
     - MEMORY-PROCESS-013 (copied from LEGION2 011): infrastructure failures alone must not force an HV DISAGREE; include this rule verbatim in every HV request.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **BDPv4 order:** mock-only contract tests, then a targeted mock gate via TestGroups, then a pinned receipt, then production, then Nuke Compile, then the binding. The full gate set runs once at the final head.
   - **TestGroups** target (`--test-groups "<project>:<Class>[,<Class>]"`, `--test-run-id`):
     - Reuses IntegrationLaneRun, IntegrationLaneClassFilter.ClassClause, IntegrationLaneFilter.PlatformClause and IntegrationLaneExecution.CheckTrx.
     - TestGroupExecution.CheckClasses checks each named class.
     - TRX lands in TestResults/<id>/groups/<project>/.
   - **Linked shared sources:** TemporaryInstanceChecks.cs is linked into 4 consumers. Test-CompileMembership.ps1 proves membership via `dotnet msbuild -getItem:Compile`.
   - **Requirement timestamps:** RequirementEntity stores CreatedAtUtc/UpdatedAtUtc strings. Server records and client models now carry DateTimeOffset?. REPL adapters format with "o" and never read a clock. A mapping reports its earliest link time.
   - **Windows route:** SSH alias LEGION2 as kingd (Invoke-LegionSsh.ps1, HostName 10.42.0.143, HostKeyAlias PAYTON-LEGION2). Text payloads travel as hex args. The interactive lane runs via a one-shot scheduled task in kingd's desktop session.
   - **Stores:** the LAB-OMARCHY and LEGION2 McpServer stores are separate; memory ids collide across stores.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **PR worktree, committed in checkpoint 611a5dc5 (parent 679eb788, 63 paths, pushed):**

Target TestGroups: RequireRunId, Compose for CurrentHost, log, WriteInventory "groups", DotNetTest with SetConfiguration and filter, EnsureCanonicalTrx, then `CheckTrx ?? CheckClasses`.
     - `build/IntegrationLaneFilter.cs`: Compose = "Category=Integration&" + PlatformClause(host). New `internal static string PlatformClause(host)` returns "Platform!=Linux" or "Platform!=Windows".
     - `build/IntegrationLaneClassFilter.cs`: new `internal static string ClassClause(names)` returns "(FullyQualifiedName~.A.|...)"; Compose uses it.
     - `tests/TestSupport.Shared/TemporaryInstanceChecks.cs`: line 173 now checks `EndsWith("__Database__Provider") || EndsWith("__DatabaseProvider") || EndsWith("DATABASE_PROVIDER")`.

     - `src/QBrainAi.Services/Requirements/RequirementsDatabaseDocumentService.cs`: MapFr/MapTr/MapTest are internal and read stored times. New `internal static FrTrMapping BuildMapping(frId, IReadOnlyCollection<RequirementTraceabilityLinkEntity> links, workspaceId)` is used by the effective view, GetAllMappingsAsync, GetMappingAsync and BuildVisibleMappings.
     - `src/QBrainAi.Client/Models/RequirementsModels.cs`: `[JsonPropertyName("createdAtUtc")]`/`updatedAtUtc` DateTimeOffset? on FrEntry/TrEntry/TestEntry; createdAtUtc on FrTrMapping.
